claims.claim: Mike Shinoda confirmed that Plaster was the working title for Linkin Park's One Step Closer. The finished song appears on Hybrid Theory, released in 2000.
claims.assessment: Shinoda quotation reproduced by fan archive; Kerrang corroborates former title. Does not identify this upload as a demo.
